column2: God willing, we'll meet tomorrow.
Thank God in every situation.

column2: Wow, God bless you.
In the name of God, let's start.
God bless you. (reply to congratulations or thanks)
May God protect you and keep you.
May God help you.
May God make it easy. (also a polite "no, thanks")

column2: It's beyond my control, it wasn't in my hands.
Oh God, protect us.
God forgive me, I didn't mean it.

column2: There is no power except with God. (said at bad news)
May God guide you. (gentle reproach)
Excuse the word, the toilet is over there.
I swear by God I didn't tell him.

Enjoy your iftar.
May your fast be blessed.
Iftar is at sunset, the call to prayer is close.

column2: Chorba and bourek are never missing from the table in Ramadan.
After the taraweeh prayers we go out for a walk.

column2: Suhoor is at 3 am, don't forget to get up.

In Ramadan work finishes early.

column2: Ramadan zlabia and qalb el louz are unbeatable.

column2: Happy Eid and many happy returns.
Happy Eid.

column2: On Eid morning we go to prayer and then visit family.

column2: The Eid money for the kids, everyone gets their share.

column2: For Eid al-Adha the sheep got very expensive this year.
On Eid day the house is full of guests.
My condolences, may God have mercy on him.
May God have mercy on her and rest her soul.
May God give you patience.
We belong to God and to Him we return.
Only God is eternal.

column2: We came to offer condolences, may it be your last sorrow.
Congratulations, may God complete it with goodness.
May God make it a good omen for you.

column2: The wedding is on Thursday in the hall, and the henna is the night before.
Zorna and bendir drums all night long.

column2: The bride wore the karakou, the gandoura and the Kabyle dress.
The tray of sweets is ready.

column2: Congratulations on the baby, may God raise them in your care.
The baby's aqiqa celebration is on Friday, you're all welcome.

column2: Congratulations on the new house, may it be a house of blessings.
May your pilgrimage be accepted and your sins forgiven.
Go safely and come back safely.
Did you arrive safely? Thank God.
Thank God you're back safe.
Come eat with us, the food is ready.
Eat, don't be shy, make yourself at home.
Coffee and tamina for the guests.
Couscous on Friday is a tradition for us.

column1: يعطيك الصحة على العشا، كانت بنينة.
column2: Thanks for dinner, it was delicious.
Enjoy it, bon appétit.

column1: يناير هو راس العام الأمازيغي، نحتفلو بيه في 12 جانفي.
column2: Yennayer is the Amazigh New Year, we celebrate it on 12 January.

column2: Algeria is a big country, each region has its own dialect and customs.

column2: Kabyle, Chaoui, Mozabite and Tuareg are all part of our identity.

column2: Chaabi from Algiers, rai from Oran and malouf from Constantine.

column2: Our Sahara is among the most beautiful places in the world.
